Maya (PM): Quick sync — customer asks keep coming about safe onprem upgrades with customer-managed networking. I sketched an MVP vs stretch list, want alignment before we take to WG. TL;DR: minimize restart blast radius, give NetOps a read-only view + optional control plane tunnel, clear rollback path.

Aj (Eng): +1. Can you paste the MVP checklist?

Maya (PM): MVP: 1) installer supports in-place minor upgrades with node drain + rolling apply; 2) documented IP/port whitelist + preflight check; 3) fallback to older runtime for 24h; 4) automated post-upgrade health probe + metrics. Stretch: BGP peering option, zero-downtime KV migration, offline image diff tool.

Kevin (Infra): Risk notes: in-place minor upgrades are doable but require deterministic DB migrations or a migration lock. Rolling applies need a drain strategy: we should default to concurrency=1 for onprem until proven.

Sara (Security): Add KMS-integration check to preflight (customer-managed KMS). Also must sign installers for air-gapped installs. Audit logs for upgrade actions are a must for enterprise.

Lena (CustSuccess): Just saw a request from AcmeHealth — they require an upgrade mode that keeps control plane read-only for 72h and must be able to revert without contacting Redwood ops. They also want a pre-upgrade dry-run report to send to their compliance team.

Aj (Eng): Proposal: implement a "dry-run" plan that runs preflight + simulated migration (no writes) and emits a report. CLI snippet:
```
redwoodctl deploy preview --cluster ./acme-cluster.yaml --report ./acme-upgrade-report.json
```
Report contains: migration steps, estimated downtime window, services touched, IP/port changes.

Kevin (Infra): Networking edge cases: many customers use NAT + overlapping IPs. Preflight must detect CIDR clashes and warn, not just fail, and offer namespace-scoped port mapping suggestions. Also we need a clear conversation about the tunnel: customers either want (A) full control plane tunnel (proxy) or (B) no tunnel and operator-run manifests. Option A has trouble with corporate egress proxies.

Maya (PM): Proposed launch gates for MVP: - docs + preflight checks implemented; - 2 customer trials (one VPC, one airgapped) completed; - rollback tested via restore script; - SLOs preserved in canary. If any are missing, mark as "alpha". Thoughts? :eyes:

Sara (Security): Add: signed manifest verification + offline signature verification test in trial. Also threat model review must be done before beta.

Aj (Eng): Scope negotiation: we can do the dry-run + rolling drain + preflight in Q2. Stretch items (BGP, zero-downtime KV migration) are heavy; put them Q3 deliberate projects. We should offer an "escape hatch": a one-click agent uninstall that triggers a graceful handover if migration fails.

Lena (CustSuccess): For comms: playbook we send customers must include: preflight checklist, expected token/key rotations, network allowlist steps, and rollback commands. I'll draft a template once you give me the CLI flags.

Kevin (Infra): Implementation detail: add a "migrate.lock" file in control-plane state. During upgrade, operator flips lock to avoid concurrent writes. Also emit trace-id for upgrade run to correlate logs.

Maya (PM): Can we get an engineering estimate? High level: dry-run + preflight + rolling drain + rollback script = 6-8 dev-weeks + 2 QA-weeks. Signing + KMS preflight + audit logs = 3-4 dev-weeks. Stretch deferred.

Aj (Eng): Ack. I'll break into two sprint epics and ping infra for the migrate.lock + trace-id hooks.

deploy-bot: CI pipeline: build/installer: 2145678920 SUCCESS — artifacts: s3://redwood-builds/onprem/v0.35.1/install.tar.gz

Maya (PM): Cool — next steps: Aj to create epics + initial PR for preflight checks. Kevin to scope migrate.lock prototype. Sara to start threat model template. Lena to prep customer dry-run template. I'll schedule WG review next Wed. :white_check_mark:

Aj (Eng): I'll post a short RFC by EOD with the preflight schema.

Lena (CustSuccess): I'll pull AcmeHealth into the trial list and ask for a point-of-contact for network testing.

Sara (Security): I'll add the signature verification test to our QA checklist.

Maya (PM): Thanks — file this under "private-deploy/upgrade-experience" in the roadmap. Ping me if anything slips.
